records.title: Unleashing the Intrinsic Visual Representation Capability of Multimodal Large Language Models
records.rights: CVF copyright retained; link-only in repository. Local analysis copies excluded from Git.
records.manualSelectionReason: Method architecture selected instead of automatic chart/teaser candidate.

records.observation: Peach visual tokens and plum text tokens recur in token rows and attention/position insets; a navy student and light-blue teacher use explicit flame/snowflake symbols.

records.transferablePrinciple: Multiple color channels are usable only when their role mappings and legends stay explicit; learn semantic continuity, not the number of colors.

records.title: FedAFD: Multimodal Federated Learning via Adversarial Fusion and Distillation
